description: Execute a prompt using Cursor's AI agent with any model id the installed cursor-agent accepts (Composer, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok families on your plan; run cursor_models for ids). Modes: 'agent' (tools, terminal, search), 'plan' (design-focused), 'ask' (read-only). In headless mode cursor-agent only PROPOSES file changes unless the server operator set CURSOR_ALLOW_YOLO=true (then --force applies them; CURSOR_SANDBOX=enabled confines them). The result lists the files changed and the model used; a client that sends a progress token gets a progress notification per tool call.

mode.description: Agent mode. 'agent' = full capabilities (file edit, terminal, search). 'plan' = design-focused, asks clarifying questions. 'ask' = read-only exploration. Default: agent.

model.description: AI model id as cursor-agent accepts it, passed through to --model (any id cursor_models lists; e.g. a Composer, Claude, GPT, Gemini or Grok id on your plan). Default: auto (Cursor picks the model). Was a closed list of old ids before 1.1.0.

prompt.description: The prompt or task for the Cursor agent. Supports natural language instructions for code generation, review, debugging, and more.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution time in seconds (10-3600). Default: 600 (10 minutes).

workspace.description: Working directory for the agent. Affects file search scope and project context. Default: server's current working directory.

name: cursor_agent

exit_code.description: cursor-agent's exit code (null when it was killed)

files_changed.description: Paths of file-tool write/edit/delete calls that reported success, in order, each once. Shell commands are not inspected: a file written by a shell tool is not listed.

files_proposed.description: Paths of file-tool write/edit/delete calls that did not report success (proposed without --force, refused, failed), each once

model.description: The model cursor-agent reported at start (its display name), if it did

noise_lines.description: stdout lines that were not stream-json events (counted, never dropped)

noise_sample.description: The first few of those lines, verbatim (500 characters each at most)

result.description: The agent's final answer; without a result event, its last message, else empty (what stdout held is in noise_sample, never here)

session_id.description: The session to resume with cursor_reply

status.description: cursor-agent's result subtype: success, error, …; no-result-event when the run ended without one

tool_calls.description: Completed tool calls the agent made
